Coverage determination. Plan: (1) map the reported peril against the policy's grant of coverage for water damage, (2) screen the standard commercial-property exclusions that bear on a pipe burst, (3) test each coverage condition, and (4) model how the $5,000 deductible / $500,000 limit apply — since no damage figure has been supplied, I'll parameterize the settlement math.

```python
import pandas as pd
from datetime import date, timedelta
import numpy as np

pd.set_option("display.width", 220)
pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth", 95)
pd.set_option("display.max_rows", 200)

TODAY = date(2026, 10, 12)
POLICY = dict(number="CP-2024-1187", eff=date(2024,1,1), exp=date(2024,12,31),
              insured="Harborview Retail LLC",
              premises="4820 Meridian Ave N, Seattle, WA 98103",
              water_limit=500_000.0, deductible=5_000.0, coinsurance_pct=None)
DOL = date(2024,11,15)

# ---------- 1. GRANT OF COVERAGE TEST ----------
grant = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Peril is "water damage" as defined in the policy","Burst/cracked plumbing pipe discharging water is the textbook ISO definition of the Water Damage peril (CP 10 30 / CP 10 20). Fits squarely.","SATISFIED","ISO CP 10 30 / CP 10 20, Water Damage peril"],
 ["Water damage coverage purchased","User confirms the policy includes water damage coverage.","SATISFIED (per user)","Declarations - unverified"],
 ["Loss at a described premises","Loss location matches the scheduled retail store.","SATISFIED (per user)","Declarations - unverified"],
 ["Loss within policy period","2024-11-15 falls 319 days into the 2024-01-01/2024-12-31 term.","SATISFIED",f"{POLICY['eff']} to {POLICY['exp']}"],
 ["Insurable interest held by claimant","Named insured owns/occupies the premises. Confirm ownership vs. leasehold.","LIKELY","Requires verification"],
 ["Peril not otherwise excluded","See exclusion screen below.","CONDITIONAL","See table 2"],
], columns=["Coverage element","Finding","Status","Authority / source"])

# ---------- 2. EXCLUSION SCREEN ----------
exc = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Exterior water / flood / surface water","EXCLUDED in base CP forms.","NOT IMPLICATED - cause is interior plumbing, not surface water. Rule out concurrent November storm intrusion.","HIGH"],
 ["Sewer or drain backup","Usually EXCLUDED in base form; restored only by a Water Backup endorsement.","NOT IMPLICATED - reported cause is supply-pipe rupture. Confirm waste-line vs. supply-line.","MEDIUM"],
 ["Constant or repeated seepage/leakage over 14 days","ISO excludes water damage from continuous seepage over 14+ days.","OPEN RISK - with a 696-day reporting delay, the carrier will probe whether the leak was gradual/ongoing rather than a single rupture.","HIGH"],
 ["Freezing of plumbing (unoccupied & unheated building)","ISO excludes freezing discharge if the building was unoccupied and heat was not maintained.","OPEN RISK - mid-November Seattle loss; a freeze-related burst raises this exclusion.","HIGH"],
 ["Wear, tear, deterioration, corrosion, rust","Pipe itself (the failed component) is NOT covered; the resulting water damage is.","LIKELY APPLIES to the pipe - reduces the repair of the pipe itself, not the ensuing damage.","MEDIUM"],
 ["Faulty / defective workmanship, repair, construction","Excluded as to the defective work; ensuing water damage generally covered.","POSSIBLE - if a recent plumbing repair caused the failure.","MEDIUM"],
 ["Vacancy (unoccupancy > 60 days before loss)","Base forms suspend/reduce coverage if the building was vacant beyond 60 days.","OPEN - must confirm occupancy status at 2024-11-15.","HIGH"],
 ["Fungus, wet rot, dry rot, bacteria","Typically limited (sub-limited), not fully excluded.","OPEN - 22-month-old water loss almost certainly produced mold/rot exposure; expect sublimit.","HIGH"],
 ["Ordinance or law","Excluded unless endorsed.","LOW - but affects code-upgrade rebuild cost.","LOW"],
 ["Neglect / failure to protect property after loss","Post-loss duty.","OPEN - prolonged period before mitigation raises this.","MEDIUM"],
 ["Earth movement, utility services, war, governmental action, nuclear","Standard absolute exclusions.","NOT IMPLICATED","LOW"],
], columns=["Exclusion / limitation","Policy treatment","Application to this loss","Materiality"])

# ---------- 3. COVERAGE CONDITIONS ----------
noticed = TODAY
cond = pd.DataFrame([
 ["Notice of loss given 'as soon as practicable'","Commercial property policies require prompt notice.","OPEN / FAILURE RISK",f"Loss {DOL} vs. intake {noticed} = {(noticed-DOL).days} days (~{(noticed-DOL).days/365.25:.1f} yrs). Well outside any reasonable prompt-notice condition."],
 ["Notice to carrier / FNOL date","Not supplied.","MISSING","Date first reported and method of reporting must be documented."],
 ["Proof of loss submitted","Not supplied.","MISSING","Signed and sworn POCL with supporting docs."],
 ["Duty to mitigate / protect property","Insured must take reasonable steps after loss.","OPEN","22-month gap invites mitigation-failure and progressive-damage arguments."],
 ["Suit-limitation clause","Policy typically bars suit 1-3 years from date of loss.","OPEN - POSSIBLE BAR",f"Claim is {(noticed-DOL).days/365.25:.1f} yrs post-loss; check the exact clause. WA statute allows parties to shorten by contract subject to reasonableness."],
 ["Insurer response deadline (WA)","WAC 284-30-380 requires acknowledgement within 10 working days and affirmation/denial within 15 working days of a properly executed proof of loss.","APPLICABLE","WA jurisdiction; runs from a complete POCL, which has not been received."],
 ["Deductible","$5,000 stated.","SATISFIED (per user)","Confirm whether it is per-occurrence, per-building, or water-damage-specific."],
 ["Limit of liability","$500,000 stated.","SATISFIED (per user)","Confirm whether it is a water damage sub-limit or a general property limit."],
 ["Coinsurance / valuation basis","Coinsurance %, RCV vs. ACV, and agreed value status not supplied.","MISSING","Drives net payment; see table 4."],
], columns=["Condition","Requirement","Status","Notes / exposure"])

print("="*150); print("TABLE 1 - GRANT OF COVERAGE TEST".ljust(150)); print("="*150)
print(grant.to_string(index=False))
print("\n"+"="*150); print("TABLE 2 - EXCLUSION / LIMITATION SCREEN".ljust(150)); print("="*150)
print(exc.to_string(index=False))
print("\n"+"="*150); print("TABLE 3 - COVERAGE CONDITIONS".ljust(150)); print("="*150)
print(cond.to_string(index=False))
```
